query:
SELECT pc.id as category_id, pc.slug, pc.name, ps.id as shoot_id
FROM portfolio_categories pc
LEFT JOIN portfolio_shoots ps ON ps.category_id = pc.id
WHERE pc.slug = 'profissional'
LIMIT 5;
